events.text: A farmer's goose guards the only bridge in town. It hates everyone.

ok.log: You slip past. The goose honks in outrage.

fail.log: It bites your leg. The town laughs.

effects.log: Everyone takes the long way.

events.text: You come home late and walk into the wrong house. The family is eating dinner.

effects.log: They laugh about it for years.
They are too surprised to stop you. The soup is great.

events.text: You sneeze in the middle of a formal ceremony. The whole hall turns around.

effects.log: Somehow it becomes part of the ceremony.
Everyone knows it was you.

events.text: A monkey steals your hat at a mountain temple.

ok.log: You get your hat back. The monkey applauds.

fail.log: The monkey wears your hat better than you.

effects.log: Fair trade. Hat returned.

events.text: A stranger greets you warmly by the wrong name and will not accept that you are someone else.

effects.log: You spend an afternoon as someone else. They owe you money, apparently. (+3 taels)
They leave, sure you have lost your memory.

events.text: A pigeon lands on your head in the market and will not leave.

effects.log: You are the pigeon master now.
It lands on the magistrate instead.

events.text: A wanted thief tries to hide from the constables by standing next to you and pretending to be your brother.

effects.log: The constables thank you.
He is caught anyway. He waves.

events.text: A noodle-eating contest at the market. The prize is a jar of rice wine.

ok.log: Eleven bowls. Champion. The wine is yours.

fail.log: Four bowls. You are defeated by a grandmother.

effects.log: The grandmother wins. She has done this before.

events.text: Villagers mistake you for a legendary hidden master because you walked in the rain without an umbrella.

effects.log: They are disappointed.
They bring you food for a week.

events.text: The neighbour's rooster crows at midnight, every night.

choices.text: Teach it to crow at dawn

effects.log: Weeks of effort. It crows at noon now.

choices.text: Buy it and give it to a farmer far away

effects.log: Silence at last. (−2 taels)

events.text: Your sword gets stuck in its scabbard just when you want to show it off.

effects.log: Everyone laughs with you.
It comes out and flies across the room.

events.text: Someone slips a love poem under your door. It is terrible. It is anonymous.

effects.log: A shy neighbour blushes whenever you pass.
The worst poem in the world, and yours.

events.text: You rent a mule that refuses to go anywhere you want to go.

effects.log: It takes you to a very nice inn.
The mule follows you happily.

events.text: A fortune-teller tells you that you will meet a tall stranger. You meet a very short one.

effects.log: She says the stranger is tall on the inside.
A good friend for a year.

events.text: A small boy challenges you to a duel to the death with a wooden spoon.

effects.log: He tells the whole village. You are his hero now.

choices.text: Teach him to hold the spoon properly

effects.log: His spoon technique improves.
